summary_en: This study tests cabozantinib plus pembrolizumab as maintenance (ongoing) treatment for metastatic squamous non-small cell lung cancer in people whose disease was controlled after four cycles of induction treatment. Cabozantinib is taken by mouth at 40 mg daily on days 1-21 of each 21-day cycle, and pembrolizumab is given as a 200 mg IV infusion on day 1 of each cycle; the total duration is not stated. The study is a Phase II trial that assesses efficacy, safety, and health-related quality of life.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa cabozantinib más pembrolizumab como tratamiento de mantenimiento (continuación) para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas de tipo escamoso metastásico, en personas cuya enfermedad se controló después de cuatro ciclos de tratamiento de inducción. El cabozantinib se toma por vía oral a 40 mg diarios en los días 1 a 21 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y el pembrolizumab se administra como infusión intravenosa de 200 mg el día 1 de cada ciclo; la duración total no se indica. El estudio es de Fase II y evalúa la eficacia, la seguridad y la calidad de vida relacionada con la salud.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with stage IV squamous non-small cell lung cancer
No prior treatment for stage IV lung cancer, apart from induction therapy in this study
Complete response, partial response, or stable disease after induction therapy
Tumor tested for PD-L1 expression and adequate organ function
not_for: Targetable genomic changes with an FDA-approved targeted therapy available
Central cavitating lung lesions or known endotracheal or endobronchial disease
Known brain metastases or cranial epidural disease not adequately treated and stable
Clinically significant bleeding within 12 weeks before first dose
